evidence: src/model.js; independent algebra and tests/model-audit.test.mjs. Model constants and policies are application assumptions, not published market observations.

timeline.entry: Valuation date t=0. F0=100/entryPE is a synthetic normalized forward earnings anchor. In the illustrative NTM convention it covers approximately holding year 1; it is not an independently verified official index EPS value.
timeline.followingValuations: At each valuation date t, Ft=F(t-1)*(1+g_t). Exactly t growth factors are applied after t elapsed holding years. Ft represents the following earnings period, approximately holding year t+1 under the illustrative NTM convention.
timeline.terminal: At exit n, Pn=exitPE*Fn. The forward anchor represents earnings following exit. Do not add another growth factor because F0 was already forward-looking.
timeline.publisherYearMapping: Annual CY/publisher-year estimates inform a uniform-accrual calendar-to-forward bridge. Six CY growth inputs generate five NTM transitions. Calendar alignment for publisher-year estimates and NTM interpretation of unspecified forward horizons are separately disclosed model assumptions. Unsupported fiscal/forecast-horizon intervals remain raw reference observations. Missing calendar inputs use sourced long-term EPS proxies; no source rate is capped, faded or replayed as raw NTM growth.
timeline.valuationPath: Mt=entryPE*(exitPE/entryPE)^(t/n), a positive geometric interpolation. Intermediate multiples are assumptions, not sourced forecasts.
timeline.dividend: At year end t, per-original-unit Dt=payout*F(t-1), or D1=100*initialYield with Dt=D1*F(t-1)/F0 in yield mode.
timeline.cash: Cash-held wealth Wcash(t)=Pt+sum(D1..Dt), no cash interest. Cash dividends are those on one original unit; investor cash flows are -100, D1, ..., Dn+Pn.
timeline.reinvestment: Existing units receive the dividend, then all proceeds buy additional units at that same year-end modeled ex-distribution price. Qt=Q(t-1)*(1+Dt/Pt), Q0=1. Wreinvest(t)=Qt*Pt. No second dividend or distribution-price deduction is applied.

returnMeasures.cashFlowIRR: Unique periodic rate r solving -100+sum(Dt/(1+r)^t)+Pn/(1+r)^n=0. Final dividend and sale are included exactly once.
returnMeasures.cashHeldWealthCAGR: ((Pn+sum(Dt))/100)^(1/n)-1; a terminal-wealth equivalent assuming zero cash interest, distinct from periodic cash-flow IRR.
returnMeasures.epsCAGR: (Fn/F0)^(1/n)-1; an equivalent geometric rate for the complete chosen path.
returnMeasures.wealthAttribution: 100 + (100*Fn/F0-100) + (Pn-100*Fn/F0) + sum(Dt) = cash-held terminal wealth. Components are sequential cumulative normalized amounts, not additive annualized returns.

solver.domain: One finite initial negative cash flow followed by non-negative finite receipts, at least one strictly positive. Projected scenarios satisfy this within supported ranges.
solver.method: Bracket and bisect log(1+r), using log-sum-exp for positive present values. Validate the rounded returned rate with a scale-relative NPV residual.
solver.failurePolicy: Reject invalid cash flows, undefined all-zero future proceeds, unrepresentable finite rates, or a failed residual check. No hardcoded negative-rate floor or positive-rate cap.

supportedScenarioDomain.note: These are calculator input limits, not source-observation plausibility limits. Unsupported observations remain visible in the data layer and must not be clamped to fit the calculator. Holding years must be integers.

assumptions.definition: Fixed opening teaching example and explicitly chosen constant-rate manual scenarios. Not consensus and not a default extrapolation of a sourced one-year estimate.
assumptions.permittedUse: Educational illustration only; source-linked scenarios use separately dated labeled yearly observations or reader assumptions.

assumptions.definition: Each chosen rate compounds the prior synthetic earnings anchor once. Per-year overrides remain reader assumptions even where a source observation exists.
assumptions.permittedUse: Annual scenario analysis; not a verified official EPS path.

assumptions.value: modeled annual NTM transitions from source CY levels and sourced long-term EPS projections
assumptions.units: percent over the publisher's labeled period
assumptions.classification: source fact plus explicit modeling assumptions
assumptions.definition: Annual CY/publisher-year estimates inform a uniform-accrual calendar-to-forward bridge. Six CY growth inputs generate five NTM transitions. Calendar alignment for publisher-year estimates and NTM interpretation of unspecified forward horizons are separately disclosed model assumptions. Unsupported fiscal/forecast-horizon intervals remain raw reference observations. Missing calendar inputs use sourced long-term EPS proxies; no source rate is capped, faded or replayed as raw NTM growth.
assumptions.permittedUse: Retain the original source period and consensus/house classification. Named-year scenario inputs and derived long-term EPS projections carry separate source provenance.

assumptions.definition: Opening teaching-example entry multiple; source-linked entry use is governed by the metric-definition registry and eligibility policy.
assumptions.permittedUse: Illustrative example or explicit manual assumption. Not a current market quotation.

assumptions.definition: Opening teaching-example multiple. Source-linked historical exits require an assessed compatible pair. Qualified dated or cross-source means remain optional reader-selected assumptions; otherwise use a verified exact-index matched TTM fallback or constant active entry P/E.
assumptions.permittedUse: Illustrative compression example. No claim of fair value or inevitable mean reversion.

assumptions.definition: A mathematical earnings anchor on the normalized starting wealth basis, not an independently verified official index EPS observation.
assumptions.permittedUse: Internally consistent scenario arithmetic; no assertion of matched publisher earnings definitions without additional evidence.

assumptions.value: benchmark-specific source dividend-anchor percent × active entry PE; 30 only in teaching example
assumptions.units: percent of the prior valuation date earnings anchor
assumptions.classification: derived model calibration or user assumption
assumptions.definition: D_t=p F_(t-1). For accepted benchmark defaults, p percent = source dividend-anchor percent × active entry PE, so D1 reproduces that benchmark anchor on initial wealth 100. This is not a publisher-reported payout ratio or matched-period D/E statistic. Missing or ineligible anchors leave the benchmark payout blank. Net-return-spread references are ineligible cash anchors.
assumptions.permittedUse: Synthetic annual scenario distributions; preserve source yield construction and separate dates. Economic feasibility is not established.

assumptions.classification: illustrative default or separately sourced initial anchor
assumptions.definition: Yield mode sets the first annual payment only. Subsequent payments scale with the prior-anchor earnings path, an application assumption; gross/net, trailing/indicated and special-distribution definitions remain in metric provenance.
assumptions.permittedUse: Labeled first-payment scenario anchor; not a forecast dividend stream, matched payout estimate or daily total-return replication.

assumptions.definition: All benchmark and manual workbench scenarios use five elapsed holding years. The generic engine supports other whole-year horizons for verification.
assumptions.permittedUse: Fixed five-year workbench and exports.

assumptions.definition: One original unit worth 100; not an actual index level, actual cash balance or currency amount.
assumptions.permittedUse: Comparable normalized scenario paths. A monetary example may scale values but cannot add currency-specific investor-return claims.

assumptions.value: annual year-end payment from prior anchor
assumptions.definition: Distributions use the start-of-year earnings anchor, paid once at year end. Intermediate modeled prices are already treated as ex-distribution.
assumptions.permittedUse: Annual educational illustration; not an official index's daily ex-date calculation.

assumptions.definition: All current units receive the annual dividend and buy additional units at the modeled year-end price, without fees or fractional-unit restrictions.
assumptions.permittedUse: Scenario reinvested wealth; can underperform holding cash when prices decline.

assumptions.definition: Entry-to-exit multiple changes at a constant proportional pace; affects interim prices and reinvestment, not terminal price given the same exit assumption.
assumptions.permittedUse: Annual path illustration and sensitivity scenarios; not a forecast valuation trajectory.

assumptions.definition: Cash distributions on one original unit accumulate without interest.
assumptions.permittedUse: Cash-held wealth only. Cash-flow IRR separately accounts for payment timing.

assumptions.value: nominal, before taxes and fees; normalized currency-neutral
assumptions.definition: No inflation adjustment, income/withholding/capital-gains taxes, fees, trading costs, FX translation or currency hedging. A source factsheet currency does not create a CAD-investor return.
assumptions.permittedUse: Illustrative valuation/dividend decomposition, not a realized investor return or after-tax projection.

assumptions.definition: Chosen per-share earnings growth may already reflect changes in shares. Buyback yield is not added on top.
assumptions.permittedUse: No separate return contribution without a different, explicitly supported model.

assumptions.value: five growth rates and five exit multiples
assumptions.definition: Growth centers on the active constant rate or equivalent CAGR; exit multiples include lower, unchanged and higher entry-relative cases where bounds allow. Axes are stable while a cell is selected. Grid alternatives use constant rates and preserve other active assumptions.
assumptions.permittedUse: Scenarios, not probabilities or confidence intervals. Bounds constrain scenarios, never source observations.

assumptions.definition: EPS-only gain is calculated first, valuation impact second, and cash dividends last. The order assigns the interaction to valuation and is not a unique economic attribution.
assumptions.permittedUse: Reconcile cumulative terminal cash-held wealth. Never add these amounts as annualized returns.

assumptions.definition: Annual CSV comes from the same accepted engine output as the table/chart. It records model version, assumptions, yearly rates, source/custom labels, snapshot context and available metric provenance. Missing context remains blank rather than invented.
assumptions.permittedUse: Rebuild the accepted scenario within the documented convention; not an official index data export.

assumptions.value: compression: 80% of entry PE, minimum 1x; constant: active entry PE; zero dividends: 0% in the active dividend mode
assumptions.definition: Each preset changes only its declared input. Compression rounds the exit multiple to two decimal places; constant P/E uses the active entry assumption. Other assumptions remain active and edited preset fields are protected.
assumptions.permittedUse: Sensitivity illustration. No claim these cases are forecasts or probabilities.

assumptions.value: eligible sourced fields or labeled fallback policy
assumptions.definition: Source following updates eligible untouched fields only. An unlocked model payout recalibrates to the source dividend anchor and active entry PE. Historical exit requires compatibility approval; otherwise the unedited exit follows active entry. Reset clears only the selected benchmark overrides and restores its five-year forecast and dividend defaults. Restore dividend defaults clears dividend overrides. Protected reader inputs remain separate. Unedited legacy 30% payouts migrate; explicit custom payouts survive.
assumptions.permittedUse: Source-linked educational scenario; protected reader inputs remain assumptions and are not evidence of a source update.

assumptions.value: earnings $10, payout $3, retained $7; EPS $10 to $10.60; share $200 to $212 plus $3; isolated ex-dividend share $200 to approximately $197 plus $3
assumptions.units: illustrative dollars per share, no specified currency
assumptions.definition: The earnings allocation is accounting profit, not proof of free cash flow or a sustainable-growth model. The one-year price case is the normalized 20x, 6%, 30% prior-anchor payout case scaled by two. The isolated ex-dividend case holds all else equal; it is not an additional deduction from the modeled terminal price.
assumptions.permittedUse: Explain accounting EPS, dividend ownership and total-return arithmetic. Not observed securities, actual index levels or CAD forecasts.

priority: verified exact-index matched untrimmed ten-year TTM mean, converted to terminal earnings basis
valuationReferencePolicy.currentValue: 100*historicalMeanPE/currentPE only for assessed compatible same-earnings-basis observations. Normalized EPS is synthetic, not independently observed official index EPS.
valuationReferencePolicy.qualifiedForward: Retained as optional reader-selected exit assumptions. They cannot automatically drive an exit or a normalized current-earnings valuation ratio. Original source dates and definition qualifications remain visible.
valuationReferencePolicy.trailingCurrent: Reference value = mean10YearTTMPE × (100/currentTTMPE). Current TTM PE and historical TTM mean must refer to the exact same index and aligned aggregation.
valuationReferencePolicy.trailingExit: The engine retains forward earnings. Projected trailing earnings at exit = terminal forward earnings/(1+final-year growth). Equivalent forward exit P/E = mean10YearTTMPE/(1+final-year growth).
valuationReferencePolicy.manualProtection: Edited exits and paused scenarios remain protected.
valuationReferencePolicy.TTMAvailability: No production TTM observations are currently connected. Synthetic QA fixtures are not production evidence.
